Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with an either-or gate: an exact fit wins, otherwise use worst fit when the spread is at least the item size or at least five bins compete, and Best Fit otherwise. The choice differs from Best Fit when either condition holds and no exact fit exists, since the loosest bin wins. Either trigger alone may justify spreading, but the or-gate can worst-fit in states where only one weak signal holds.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    spread = max(bins) - min(bins)
    n = len(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if spread >= item or n >= 5 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
